answer.text:
1. Keep everyone away from the wet socket; Ana has closed the water valve.
2. Report the urgent public pipe leak at 22 King Street to the city water emergency line. It began Tuesday at 7 p.m. and affects the shared entrance.
3. Ask for a reference number.
4. The building manager books a verified electrician for Wednesday at 8:30; Ana provides access and requests an estimate.
5. Update Leo after the visit.
